paragraphs.text: Beatriz Hinojosa Rentería was arrested in Arrest VER-11-01 on 2011-05-21. Pacto del Faro Gris was linked to Arrest VER-11-01 on 2011-05-21. Arrest VER-11-01 occurred at Veracruz on 2011-05-21. Regional press reporting from the Gulf coast described the arrest by federal forces of Hinojosa, identified in the press as a plaza boss for Pacto del Faro Gris operating under the nickname La Tortuga, at a residence in the port district of Veracruz. The published accounts stated that weapons and cash were recovered and that Hinojosa was transferred to the capital the same day. The accounts also stated that Hinojosa had been under investigation for several months and that the arrest had been timed to coincide with a port inspection, although no seizure at the port was reported in the same items.

Ignacio Treviño Salcido led Pacto del Faro Gris from 2011-01-22 until 2016-03-09. One columnist described Treviño as the head of the pact since its formation and speculated that the arrest reflected a dispute within the pact over the division of the Tuxpan docks. The column offered no source for the speculation and the reporting office does not assess it as reliable.

This digest summarizes open press reporting and carries no classification beyond the public domain. The reporting office has not corroborated the press accounts through its own sources. The press items were consistent with each other on the place and date of the arrest but differed on the quantity of cash recovered, which the reporting office has omitted. Readers should note that the pact's figures have appeared in the Gulf press under several nicknames and that attribution of the nickname in this item is the columnist's.
